name: PNGGPU WebGPU and optional Turing CUDA source package
distribution_type: cumulative Windows one-click installer; pinned original PNG2ANSI source downloaded once if absent
features: folder image batch to ANSI ZIP
explicit backend selection and benchmark provenance
CUDA native host tests and Windows/Linux compiler CI
vram_policy: manual VRAM; warn above VRAM-4GiB; hard block above VRAM-2GiB; estimates do not equal actual free memory
hardware_GPU_validation: Not performed in container; high-resolution streaming exact-reference parity unverified

optional_cuda.physical_gpu_qualification: pending: no physical CUDA GPU available in implementation environment

file_hash_policy: SHA-256 and byte sizes after CRLF-to-LF normalization for text; raw bytes for binary. Manifest excludes itself.
